correctness.rationale: The eight binary cubic reductions are exhaustive. Their exact root-count contributions are proved by unique simple Hensel lifts, a bijective quadratic discriminant parameterization, classical explicit dyadic square-root fibers and the complete zero/two/scaled triple-root partition. The scaled branch has exactly sixteen coefficient lifts per lower-level cubic. The three initial levels and the square-root maximum comparison yield all-level recursion, maxima and extremizer counts. Direct standalone enumeration of all 299592 cubics through the sixth power of two, 2097152 cubics modulo 128 and 24 recurrence levels verified independently using exact integers. Finite computation is supporting evidence, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact full root-count distribution over all binary prime-power moduli is a natural finite-level arithmetic invariant with rare large singular clusters. The three-step renormalization, sharp 2,3,5 extremal pattern, precise maximizing-cubic multiplicities and 1/32 decay of maximal-event probability are structural results valid for infinitely many moduli. They are not determined by expected-root counts, existing Q_2-root distribution, or isolated enumerations; extension to other degrees and primes is left open.
